description: Unblocking and fresh web data for AI agents: any URL in, clean Markdown out, plus Instagram, TikTok, Reddit, YouTube, X, LinkedIn, Amazon and Google data as JSON. This A2A agent is free and read-only: it answers questions about the API and explains which endpoint fits a task and how to get its quote. It places no paid calls, signs no payments and holds no accounts. Paid calls go over HTTP (https://agdata.shveik.dev/openapi.json) or MCP (https://agdata.shveik.dev/mcp), paid in stablecoins.
name: agdata

skills.description: Answers questions about the agdata API: its endpoints, request shapes, how a call is paid (x402 or MPP, stablecoins) and where the full docs are (https://agdata.shveik.dev/docs, https://agdata.shveik.dev/agents.md, https://agdata.shveik.dev/openapi.json). Free; it runs no scraping.
